run_f_gold: run f_gold to find the maximum distance between two occurrences of the same element in an array
test_f_gold: test f_gold against multiple parameter sets and compare results with f_filled
review_f_gold: review f_gold which uses a dictionary to track first occurrence indices of array elements
summarize_f_gold: summarize f_gold that returns the maximum distance between two occurrences of any element
refactor_f_gold: refactor f_gold to avoid using mp.keys() and instead check membership directly in the dictionary
